description: This file defines the Vtiger_Access class, which provides an API for managing access control features such as sharing permissions, sharing rules initialization, tool enablement, and default sharing settings within the vtiger CRM module.

classes.name: Vtiger_Access
classes.description: Provides API to control Access like Sharing, Tools etc. for vtiger CRM Module

methods.name: log
methods.description: Helper function to log messages using Vtiger_Utils

methods.name: __getDefaultSharingAccessId
methods.description: Get unique id for sharing access record

methods.name: allowSharing
methods.description: Enable or Disable sharing access control to module

methods.name: initSharing
methods.description: Initialize sharing access for a module

methods.name: deleteSharing
methods.description: Delete sharing access setup for a module

methods.name: setDefaultSharing
methods.description: Set default sharing permission for a module

methods.name: updateTool
methods.description: Enable or disable a tool/action for a module
